correctness.rationale: The verifier reconstructs the exact 150-facet complex from the published S6 generators and facet representatives. Global ranks are rank(d3)=225 and rank(d4)=149, hence H3(F2) has dimension one. Exhaustion of all 8008 ten-sets excludes supports of size at most ten. Exhaustion of all 4368 eleven-sets finds exactly 150 nonzero global carriers, proves they equal the facet complements, verifies local H3 is one-dimensional on each complement and zero on every other eleven-set, and computes the 30+120 symmetry orbits.

value.rationale: For a vertex-minimal triangulation of RP4, the unique nonzero mod-two H3 class is a canonical topological invariant. Its exact minimum vertex support and complete carrier family are natural combinatorial systolic data.
